searchQueries.query: Gomel Homel Belarus cadastral agency land parcel GIS regional agency Homel cadastral map
searchQueries.executionMethod: Separate English-language web search followed by primary local agency and NCA service review.
searchQueries.result: The Gomel agency's official site identifies the agency, registration services and its Gomel city/branch service scope. The NCA public map publishes a parcel WFS layer. A viewer-compatible bounded 2 m query returned one nearby parcel with object_id 6722720, but point-in-ring placed it outside the unchanged WUP point; a subsequent exact INTERSECTS query returned zero features. No parcel is claimed at the point.

searchQueries.query: Гомельское агентство по государственной регистрации земельному кадастру карта участков официальный
searchQueries.executionMethod: Separate Russian-language web search followed by primary local agency and NCA service review.
searchQueries.result: Официальный сайт РУП «Гомельское агентство по государственной регистрации и земельному кадастру» подтверждает местного регистратора и землеустроительные функции; страница структуры указывает обслуживание города Гомеля и отдельную зону Гомельского филиала. В открытой карте Национального кадастрового агентства найден WFS-слой земельных участков. Ограниченный запрос в радиусе 2 м вернул соседний полигон object_id 6722720, но точка WUP находится вне его; точный запрос INTERSECTS вернул ноль объектов. Наличие участка в точке не утверждается.

localRegistryCustody.agency: РУП «Гомельское агентство по государственной регистрации и земельному кадастру»
localRegistryCustody.evidence: The agency's official homepage and service pages identify the organization and state-registration/land-management functions. The official branch page says the Gomel Agency serves Gomel city except Novobelitsky District; the Gomel branch covers Gomel District and Novobelitsky District. Exact administrative sub-area placement of the WUP point was not independently overlaid.

parcelService.capabilitiesEvidence: Existing anonymous GetCapabilities response names the parcel polygon layer and DefaultCRS urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326. WGS84BoundingBox is expressed as longitude, latitude, consistent with response GeoJSON coordinates.
parcelService.schemaEvidence: DescribeFeatureType declares object_id as a non-null long and geom as a geometry property; it also contains address/cad_num/purpose/organization/status attributes. Geometry query explicitly selected only object_id and geom.

currentMetadataProbe.headers: Ordinary Origin: https://map.nca.by and Referer: https://map.nca.by/, matching official viewer route; no cookies or credentials.

attempts.result: Layer metadata names Земельные участки and DefaultCRS urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326.
Schema confirms safe object_id and geom fields; other sensitive/property fields were not requested.

attempts.operation: Fresh same-origin capabilities/schema probe (standard public viewer Origin/Referer headers; no cookies)
attempts.result: Current metadata confirms the parcel layer and DefaultCRS EPSG:4326; DescribeFeatureType also returned HTTP 200 and confirms object_id and geom.

One full polygon returned, object_id 6722720, only object_id and geom requested. Ring has 18 coordinate tuples including closure. It is a nearby feature; point-in-ring check returned false, so the polygon was not retained as a WUP-point sample.
Empty FeatureCollection (numberReturned 0) at the unchanged WUP coordinate. This is a service query result only and is not interpreted as proof that no legal parcel exists at the locator.

attempts.operation: Bare metadata GET without viewer Origin/Referer
attempts.result: A bare request was denied; this was not retried with cookies or other access-control workarounds. The official viewer-compatible same-origin metadata request succeeded.

geometryDecision: One complete nearby Polygon is retained as official-source geometry evidence with only the safe native object_id and geometry. It was returned by the official 2 m DWITHIN query but does not contain the exact WUP locator; the exact INTERSECTS result remains empty.
remainingUncertainty: The exact WUP point did not intersect a returned feature in this layer. The reason (mapping gap, locator on a non-parcel area, or other source coverage behavior) is unknown; the exact local agency sub-area division was also not checked against an official boundary overlay.
